newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN INT'L BANK FINED BY SECURITIES COMMISSION.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN INT'L BANK FINED BY SECURITIES COMMISSION.

text.p: The securities commission has slapped the Latvian International Bank, one of the smallest banks operating in the country, with a 500 lat fine for conducting securities transactions without a license.
"They had no license yet they had activities on the securities market," Viktors Gustons, the head of the securities commission, told Reuters.
The commission said in a statement that the bank was banned from all further activities on the market until it obtains a license.
Gustons said the commission would decide at its next meeting when the bank would be allowed to apply for a license. The date of the meeting has not been set yet, he said.
